paper.title_en: From Resonance Properties to High-Energy Behavior: The $R$ Ratio from Lattice QCD
paper.abstract_en: We investigate resonance properties and inclusive spectral behavior through Bayesian reconstruction of the $R$-ratio from Euclidean lattice correlators near the physical pion mass. Without additional Gaussian smearing, the reconstructed spectrum already captures the smooth high-energy behavior observed in experiment. Direct integration of the $ρ$ peak determines $f_ρ$ with approximately $1\%$ statistical precision and close agreement with the experimental reference, providing access to resonance properties without resolving individual finite-volume levels. With a common Gaussian width of $σ=0.6$~GeV, the lattice and experimental $R$-ratios show good overall agreement over $0.25$--$2.50$~GeV. Comparisons among ensembles with spatial extents up to approximately $10$~fm demonstrate that finite-volume effects can be controlled across these complementary observables. These results demonstrate a unified framework for studying resonance and inclusive physics from lattice QCD, with potential applications to other hadronic channels, inclusive decay rates, and hadronic tensors.
